top_signals.title: LNG WRAP: Bangladesh Seeks More Cargoes as Iran War Drags On
top_signals.summary: Bangladesh is seeking additional liquefied natural gas cargoes as the Iran war continues to disrupt flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: "As a smaller, more open economy, Canada has more to lose from this," ING strategists said Monday.
